steps.content: The gravel is loose, and the seaweed is soft. L.L. is wrapped in seawater, roaming every corner of Elysiland.
Everything or everyone that interests her receives her favor, making her the most exciting participant, sharing the joy.
...But it's still not enough, she wants more. This is no longer thrilling. With so many people, there must be something more exciting, more joyful, more...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Let me join you! Let me play with you more and have more fun!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Anything, anything! Even if it means becoming a part of your play, that's okay!
L.L.'s words are like water droplets falling into hot oil, turning everyone frantic. Watching people eagerly offer themselves, L.L.'s excitement becomes more evident.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Come try out the boss chair, made from the leather of my boss at work!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Of course, the island owner should come to us! I saw on the forum before that someone really wanted us to bring some posts from the Elysiland forum to life. Look, I've recreated them all!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest C
steps.content: Wait, wait, don't worry about that! Come... have another drink, baby...
A beautiful glass tumbles over, and L.L. smiles as she takes it—
The moment L.L.'s fingers touch it, a crisp shattering sound is heard. The glass and the guest both shatter into snow-white fragments, drifting away like the wind. She is momentarily stunned.
The seawater surrounding the island becomes increasingly deep and gradually turns pitch black like thick ink.
L.L. gazes at the restless fish above her, the seawater distorting its cries into different vibrations. L.L. reaches a hand out to feel it.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The energy at the seabed is not right...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: ...Something has sneaked in...
People look at each other and then return to their revelry, thinking it's just a little show prepared by the island owner, even whistling for an encore.
Bang!
And Elysiland seems to respond to the guests' requests. Before others can react, one by one, they turn into snowflakes in front of L.L.

Before the guests' eyes, like a signal disruption, gray snowflakes flash. The entwined couple turns into powder, the dancing people spin into petals, and the laughing ones fall back, never to rise again, turning into a field of gravel.
Suddenly, a dead silence falls around. The remaining people rub their eyes, look at each other, then erupt in sharp screams.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guests
steps.content: Ahhh!!!
L.L., though taking the glass, stares vigilantly in the direction where the seabed wind blows.
The huge fish leaps down from above, howling anxiously in that direction. But not just it, even Manty has not detected anyone intruding into the Elysiland network submerged in the seabed.
The culprit must have a formidable helper to allow him to enter the seabed of Elysiland.
steps.female_content: The culprit must have a formidable helper to allow her to enter the seabed of Elysiland.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Oh... looks like someone wants to stir up a storm under the sea...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Driving away my guests, destroying the joy and perfection on the island...
L.L. retracts her hand, smiling as she reassures the guests who witnessed everything.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Why are you shaking? Don't be afraid. This is Elysiland, and I'm the creator and owner of this island.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I won't let my guests be harmed or neglected.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Someone is causing trouble on my island, I won't let him get away with it.
steps.female_content: Someone is causing trouble on my island, I won't let her get away with it.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Hey, or we could invite him to join us, and he'll be so happy he'll cry, bowing and thanking us for letting him enjoy with us!
steps.female_content: Hey, or we could invite her to join us, and she'll be so happy she'll cry, bowing and thanking us for letting her enjoy with us!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Inviting such tasteless people, tsk, don't bring them here, or they'll dirty my place!
L.L. shakes her head, stopping the crowd's discussion.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I can probably guess who it is—It's that person in the gray trench coat.
L.L. shrugs, floating up, overlooking her guests, stirring the now-calm seawater, guiding them to continue satisfying themselves.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: It's okay, you have me, and I will always stand by your side.
Following the guidance of Elysiland's creator, the guests are once again caught up in a whirlpool of frenzy and chaos.
Occasionally, a hand reaches out, trying to touch L.L.'s hem, asking her to quickly address the issue and join their play, so they can be happy forever.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guests
steps.content: Let's get rid of him! Drive him away!!
steps.female_content: Let's get rid of her! Drive her away!!

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guests
steps.content: Such a person must be a cancer! A terrible disease! We can't have such a person here!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Ah... don't worry, I'll handle it.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You guys just continue your revelry. Leave the killjoy to me.
L.L. floats beside the fish, gently calming its agitation, her eyes gradually becoming playful.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Besides... now that he's on Elysiland, why not look forward to him becoming one of us?
steps.female_content: Besides... now that she's on Elysiland, why not look forward to her becoming one of us?
